section.title: About this corpus
section.prose: This is the central index of the gandr specification corpus. Each component is a status-attributed unit authored in the custom component vocabulary and validated by the doc tool (parse equals validate).

section.title: Conventions
section.prose: Every component declares a required status, defines its terms inline (define-once corpus-wide), declares its cite keys, and records typed provenance edges. The designed build will render no-JavaScript static pages; math and diagram leaves will compile to inline vector graphics.
